  "narrative_text": "Across three complementary enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-DB ORA, MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA, and Mummichog m/z-direct activity — the unanimous top hit is arachidonic acid metabolism and its downstream eicosanoid cascade. In the RaMP analysis (FDR=6.8×10⁻¹⁴, fold-enrichment=1430×, WP:WP167 'Eicosanoid synthesis'), five of the seven input metabolites cluster together: arachidonic acid (CHEBI:15843), 5-HETE (CHEBI:28209), 15-HETE (CHEBI:15558), leukotriene A4 (CHEBI:15651), and 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J2 (CHEBI:34159). react_result.final_narrative_text: Across three complementary enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-DB ORA, MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA, and Mummichog m/z-direct activity — the unanimous top hit is arachidonic acid metabolism and its downstream eicosanoid cascade. In the RaMP analysis (FDR=6.8×10⁻¹⁴, fold-enrichment=1430×, WP:WP167 'Eicosanoid synthesis'), five of the seven input metabolites cluster together: arachidonic acid (CHEBI:15843), 5-HETE (CHEBI:28209), 15-HETE (CHEBI:15558), leukotriene A4 (CHEBI:15651), and 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J2 (CHEBI:34159). The MetaboAnalystR KEGG result (hsa00590 'Arachidonic acid metabolism') independently confirms arachidonic acid, LTA4, 15-HETE, and 5-HETE as pathway members. The Mummichog m/z network achieves 100% overlap (11/11 compounds) on the 'Arachidonic acid metabolism' module (p=0.00076), with the same four eicosanoid compounds serving as the overlap set. Arachidonic acid serves as the common substrate; the 5- and 15-lipoxygenase branches generate HETEs and leukotrienes respectively, while the cyclooxygenase branch gives rise to the prostaglandin J2 analogue. 15-Deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-PGJ2 is a cyclopentenone prostaglandin that can act as a PPARγ agonist and electrophilic stress mediator. Glycolaldehyde (CHEBI:17071) and losartan (CHEBI:6541) did not co-enrich with the eicosanoid cluster and appear to be unrelated outliers in this dataset. Limitations: FELLA random-walk and Reactome SSPA were unavailable, preventing graph-diffusion and curated-human Reactome ORA confirmation; the absence of these tools means indirect network relationships around losartan could not be assessed.
